up:
Retrieve the first 1000 activity records for the target molecule CHEMBL1795176 (N-lysine methyltransferase KMT5A) in humans (target type: single protein, tax_id: 9606, target CHEMBL ID: CHEMBL1795176). Specifically: 
• Filter activities where standard_type = 'IC50' and pChEMBL value is NOT NULL (i.e., exact standard relation '=' with a defined numeric pChEMBL value).
• Return assay ChEMBL ID (from assay.chembl_id), target type (from target_dictionary.target_type), target tax_id (from target_dictionary.tax_id), compound canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard_type (IC50), and pChEMBL value.
• Include only rows where assay_target is a single protein (target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN') and the assay organism is human (target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606).
• Order results by molecule_chembl_id ascending, then assay_chembl_id ascending.
• Ensure exactly 1000 rows are returned (first 1000 by order).
sql:
WITH activities_by_mol AS (
  SELECT a.activity_id, a.assay_id, a.molecule_chembl_id
  FROM activities a
  WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  td.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities_by_mol a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795176'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.tax_id = 9606
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
